main_verdict: The Wave-1 manuscripts should cite SDSS/BPT/demarcation/catalog sources for actual optical pilot measurements, and cite physical AGN/environment/outflow literature only as status or follow-up motivation unless the missing non-SDSS observables are added.
overclaim_guards: M1 RP-2: nearest-neighbour density proxy is not halo mass, central/satellite status, or causal environmental quenching.
M1 RP-3: optical BPT AGN fraction is not radio jet power, X-ray cavity power, cooling luminosity, or duty-cycle balance.
M2 P1: high-excitation optical AGN count is not outflow velocity, escape velocity, molecular/neutral gas phase coverage, recycling time, or escape fraction.
